meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who entered the zero on Owen's essay, and why did nobody call me first?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.
So you decided on a machine's guess. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish anything, and I have the vendor's guide in my bag saying the same. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn and an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and she still plans to go to the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, because the meeting ended after one exchange, well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered only the checker score and no evidence tied to Owen's own work.
What cost ground: You gave the detector score as your whole reason for the zero, which she dismisses as a machine's guess that the vendor and the school's own procedure say cannot stand alone.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
